## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Period = as.numeric(Period),
    Indicator = case_when(
      grepl("Births in the unit", Data) ~ "Births in unit",
      grepl("ANC 1st Visit", Data) ~ "ANC 1st Visit"
    )
  )
print(df2)


ggplot(df2, aes(x = Period, y = Value, 
                color = Indicator, group = Indicator)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2020:2025) +
  labs(
    title = "Births in Unit vs ANC 1st Visits, 2020–2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of clients",
    color = "Indicator"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
#******************************************************************#
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
